# 1. Libraries

Required packages:

``` r
install.packages(c("RColorBrewer", "patchwork"))
BiocManager::install(c("ComplexHeatmap", "circlize",
                       "org.Mm.eg.db", "clusterProfiler",
                       "msigdbr", "reactome.db", "GSVA", "biomaRt"))
```

# 3. Load module membership and pathway gene lists

```{r helpers_load}
find_latest_dated_dir <- function(base) {
  dirs  <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  dated <- sort(dirs[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(dirs))],
                decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(dated) == 0) stop("No dated subdirectory under: ", base)
  cat("Using:", dated[1], "\n")
  dated[1]
}

parse_gene_set <- function(gene_str) {
  if (is.na(gene_str) || gene_str == "") return(character(0))
  unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(gene_str), "/"))))
}
```

```{r load_modules}
dir_04_3    <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.3_pathway_network"))
modules_csv <- file.path(dir_04_3, "pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv")

if (!file.exists(modules_csv))
  stop("pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv not found — run 04.3 first.\n", modules_csv)

all_modules_df <- read.csv(modules_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    module     = as.character(module),
    source_db  = sub("\\|.*$",    "", node_id),
    pathway_id = sub("^[^|]+\\|", "", node_id)
  )

cat("Module entries loaded:", nrow(all_modules_df), "\n")
cat("Tissues:", paste(sort(unique(all_modules_df$tissue)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 4. Module gene sets from enrichment hit genes (geneID)

For each module, use the union of the geneID entries (i.e., the genes actually identified as hits) from the 04_GO_KEGG enrichment results as the module gene set.

```{r load_enrichment_csv}
base_04   <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04_GO_KEGG")
input_dir <- find_latest_dated_dir(base_04)

safe_read_enrich <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) { cat("Not found — skipped:", basename(path), "\n"); return(NULL) }
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Loaded", nrow(df), "rows from:", basename(path), "\n")
  df
}

go_bp_all    <- safe_read_enrich(file.path(input_dir, "GO",       "GO_BP_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
kegg_all     <- safe_read_enrich(file.path(input_dir, "KEGG",     "KEGG_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
msigdb_all   <- safe_read_enrich(file.path(input_dir, "MSigDB",   "MSigDB_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
reactome_all <- safe_read_enrich(file.path(input_dir, "Reactome", "Reactome_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))

add_source_enrich <- function(df, src) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(geneID), geneID != "") %>%
    mutate(source  = src,
           node_id = paste0(src, "|", ID)) %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, node_id, geneID)
}

msigdb_rows <- if (!is.null(msigdb_all) && nrow(msigdb_all) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(unique(msigdb_all$msigdb_set), function(s) {
    add_source_enrich(msigdb_all %>% filter(msigdb_set == s), paste0("MSigDB:", s))
  }))
} else NULL

all_enrich_hits <- bind_rows(
  add_source_enrich(go_bp_all,    "GO BP"),
  add_source_enrich(kegg_all,     "KEGG"),
  add_source_enrich(reactome_all, "Reactome"),
  msigdb_rows
)

cat("Total enrichment entries with geneID:", nrow(all_enrich_hits), "\n")
```

```{r db_pathway_genes}
mod_ids <- all_modules_df %>% distinct(source_db, pathway_id)

msigdb_source_map <- tibble(
  source_db   = c("MSigDB:Hallmark", "MSigDB:C2_KEGG",
                  "MSigDB:C2_Reactome", "MSigDB:C2_WikiPathways"),
  category    = c("H",  "C2",  "C2",  "C2"),
  subcategory = c(NA,   "CP:KEGG", "CP:REACTOME", "CP:WIKIPATHWAYS")
)

msigdb_full <- bind_rows(lapply(
  intersect(msigdb_source_map$source_db, unique(mod_ids$source_db)),
  function(src) {
    row <- msigdb_source_map[msigdb_source_map$source_db == src, ]
    df  <- if (is.na(row$subcategory))
      msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = row$category)
    else
      msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = row$category,
              subcategory = row$subcategory)
    df %>%
      filter(gs_name %in% mod_ids$pathway_id[mod_ids$source_db == src]) %>%
      mutate(source = src) %>%
      dplyr::select(source, ID = gs_name, symbol = gene_symbol)
  }
))

go_ids_need <- mod_ids$pathway_id[mod_ids$source_db == "GO BP"]
go_full <- if (length(go_ids_need) > 0) {
  tryCatch({
    AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = go_ids_need,
                          columns = c("SYMBOL", "ONTOLOGY"), keytype = "GO") %>%
      filter(ONTOLOGY == "BP", !is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
      mutate(source = "GO BP") %>%
      dplyr::select(source, ID = GO, symbol = SYMBOL) %>%
      distinct()
  }, error = function(e) { cat("GO BP lookup failed:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
} else NULL

kegg_ids_need <- mod_ids$pathway_id[mod_ids$source_db == "KEGG"]
kegg_full <- if (length(kegg_ids_need) > 0) {
  tryCatch({
    kegg_data <- clusterProfiler::download_KEGG("mmu")
    p2g <- kegg_data$KEGGPATHID2EXTID %>%
      rename(ID = from, entrezid = to) %>%
      filter(ID %in% kegg_ids_need)
    sym_map <- bitr(unique(p2g$entrezid), fromType = "ENTREZID",
                    toType = "SYMBOL", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
    p2g %>%
      left_join(sym_map, by = c("entrezid" = "ENTREZID")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
      mutate(source = "KEGG") %>%
      dplyr::select(source, ID, symbol = SYMBOL) %>%
      distinct()
  }, error = function(e) { cat("KEGG lookup failed:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
} else NULL

reactome_ids_need <- mod_ids$pathway_id[mod_ids$source_db == "Reactome"]
reactome_full <- if (length(reactome_ids_need) > 0 &&
                     requireNamespace("reactome.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tryCatch({
    library(reactome.db)
    r2e <- as.data.frame(reactomePATHID2EXTID) %>%
      filter(DB_ID %in% reactome_ids_need)
    sym_map_r <- bitr(unique(r2e$gene_id), fromType = "ENTREZID",
                      toType = "SYMBOL", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
    r2e %>%
      left_join(sym_map_r, by = c("gene_id" = "ENTREZID")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
      mutate(source = "Reactome") %>%
      dplyr::select(source, ID = DB_ID, symbol = SYMBOL) %>%
      distinct()
  }, error = function(e) { cat("Reactome lookup failed:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
} else { cat("reactome.db not available — skipped.\n"); NULL }

pathway_db_genes <- bind_rows(msigdb_full, go_full, kegg_full, reactome_full)
cat("DB genes fetched for",
    n_distinct(paste(pathway_db_genes$source, pathway_db_genes$ID)), "pathways\n")
```

```{r module_gene_sets}
pathway_hit_genes <- all_enrich_hits %>%
  group_by(tissue, node_id) %>%
  summarise(
    target_genes = list(unique(unlist(lapply(geneID, parse_gene_set)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pathway_db_gene_list <- pathway_db_genes %>%
  mutate(node_id = paste0(source, "|", ID)) %>%
  group_by(node_id) %>%
  summarise(db_genes = list(unique(symbol)), .groups = "drop")

module_gene_meta <- all_modules_df %>%
  left_join(pathway_hit_genes,    by = c("tissue", "node_id")) %>%
  left_join(pathway_db_gene_list, by = "node_id") %>%
  group_by(tissue, module) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_union        = list(unique(unlist(db_genes[!sapply(db_genes,      is.null)]))),
    target_gene_union = list(unique(unlist(target_genes[!sapply(target_genes, is.null)]))),
    n_pathways        = n_distinct(pathway_id),
    .groups           = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_genes        = lengths(gene_union),
    n_target_genes = lengths(target_gene_union),
    module_id      = paste0(tissue, "_mod", module)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_genes > 0)

module_gene_meta <- module_gene_meta %>%
  mutate(
    exclusive_gene_union = map2(gene_union, target_gene_union,
                                function(gu, tgu) setdiff(gu, tgu)),
    n_exclusive_genes    = lengths(exclusive_gene_union)
  )

cat("Tissue-modules with gene sets:", nrow(module_gene_meta), "\n\n")
module_gene_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module, module_id, n_pathways,
                n_genes, n_target_genes, n_exclusive_genes) %>%
  arrange(tissue, as.integer(module)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# 4b. Diagnostics: module filtering funnel (steps 0–1)

```{r filter_diagnostics}
step0 <- all_modules_df %>% distinct(tissue, module) %>% mutate(step = "0_all_modules")
step1 <- module_gene_meta %>% distinct(tissue, module) %>% mutate(step = "1_gene_set_ok")

dropped_modules <- all_modules_df %>%
  distinct(tissue, module) %>%
  anti_join(module_gene_meta %>% distinct(tissue, module), by = c("tissue", "module")) %>%
  mutate(reason = "no geneID hit genes found in enrichment results")

cat("=== Filtering funnel (steps 0–1) ===\n")
cat("Step 0 — tissue-modules in pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv:", nrow(step0), "\n")
cat("Step 1 — after geneID hit-gene check                      :", nrow(step1), "\n")
cat("  Dropped:", nrow(step0) - nrow(step1), "\n")
if (nrow(dropped_modules) > 0) print(dropped_modules %>% arrange(tissue, as.integer(module)), n = Inf)
```

# 5. Load mRNA expression data and miRNA-target pairs

```{r load_expr}
find_expr_csv <- function(tissue) {
  fname    <- paste0(tissue, "_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv")
  base     <- file.path(wd_mrna, "output", tissue)
  f        <- file.path(base, fname)
  if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
  all_dirs <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  dated    <- sort(all_dirs[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(all_dirs))],
                   decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in dated) { f <- file.path(d, fname); if (file.exists(f)) return(f) }
  NULL
}

tissue_expr_raw <- setNames(lapply(tissues, function(tis) {
  f <- find_expr_csv(tis)
  if (is.null(f)) { cat("Expression file not found:", tis, "\n"); return(NULL) }
  df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!all(c("symbol", "sample.ID", "Log2TPM", "timepoint") %in% names(df))) {
    cat("Missing expected columns in:", tis, "\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(symbol, sample.ID, Log2TPM, timepoint) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Log2TPM), !is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
    mutate(replicate = as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", sample.ID)))
}), tissues)
tissue_expr_raw <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tissue_expr_raw)

tissue_expr_raw <- lapply(tissue_expr_raw, function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, ordered = TRUE))
})

cat("Expression data loaded for:", paste(names(tissue_expr_raw), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 5b. Gene lengths (covariate for logistic regression)

```{r gene_lengths}
gene_len_tbl <- tryCatch({
  mart <- biomaRt::useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
  df   <- biomaRt::getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "transcript_length"), mart = mart)
  df %>%
    rename(symbol = external_gene_name) %>%
    filter(!is.na(transcript_length), symbol != "") %>%
    group_by(symbol) %>%
    summarise(gene_length = max(transcript_length), .groups = "drop")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("biomaRt unavailable:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  cat("gene_length covariate will be omitted from logistic regression.\n")
  NULL
})
if (!is.null(gene_len_tbl)) cat("Gene lengths retrieved for", nrow(gene_len_tbl), "symbols\n")
```

# Helper functions

```{r gsva_helpers}
make_expr_mat <- function(expr_long) {
  expr_long %>%
    dplyr::select(symbol, sample.ID, Log2TPM) %>%
    group_by(symbol, sample.ID) %>%
    summarise(Log2TPM = mean(Log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample.ID, values_from = Log2TPM, values_fill = NA_real_) %>%
    column_to_rownames("symbol") %>%
    as.matrix()
}

run_gsva_safe <- function(expr_mat, gene_sets, min_sz = 1) {
  valid <- Filter(function(gs) length(gs) >= min_sz, gene_sets)
  if (length(valid) == 0) return(NULL)
  tryCatch({
    param <- gsvaParam(exprData = expr_mat, geneSets = valid,
                       kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = min_sz, maxSize = Inf)
    gsva(param, verbose = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e1) {
    tryCatch(
      gsva(expr_mat, valid, method = "gsva", kcdf = "Gaussian",
           min.sz = min_sz, verbose = FALSE),
      error = function(e2) { cat("  GSVA failed:", conditionMessage(e2), "\n"); NULL }
    )
  })
}

gsva_to_long <- function(gsva_mat, tis, expr_raw) {
  samp_meta <- expr_raw %>% distinct(sample.ID, timepoint, replicate)
  as.data.frame(gsva_mat) %>%
    rownames_to_column("module_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(-module_id, names_to = "sample.ID", values_to = "score") %>%
    left_join(samp_meta, by = "sample.ID") %>%
    mutate(tissue = tis, module = sub(".*_mod", "", module_id))
}

safe_hclust <- function(mat, method = "ward.D2", dist_method = "euclidean",
                        reorder_by = NULL) {
  if (nrow(mat) <= 1) return(FALSE)
  m <- mat; m[!is.finite(m)] <- 0
  d <- if (dist_method == "correlation") as.dist(1 - cor(t(m))) else dist(m, method = dist_method)
  hc <- tryCatch(hclust(d, method = method), error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (isFALSE(hc) || is.null(reorder_by)) return(hc)
  tryCatch(
    as.hclust(reorder(as.dendrogram(hc), reorder_by, agglo.FUN = mean)),
    error = function(e) hc
  )
}

row_peak_weights <- function(mat) {
  apply(mat, 1, function(row) {
    row[!is.finite(row)] <- 0
    w <- pmax(row, 0)
    if (sum(w) < 1e-10) return(ncol(mat) / 2)
    sum(seq_along(row) * w) / sum(w)
  })
}

# Shared GSVA color scale (symmetric diverging, -1 to 1)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027"))
```

# 6. Logistic regression: miRNA-target enrichment per module

Unit of observation: each gene detected in the tissue.
Outcome `is_target`: 1 if gene is a miRNA negative-cosine target in this tissue.
Predictor `in_module`: 1 if gene belongs to this module's `gene_union` ∩ detected.
Covariates: `expression_level` (mean Log2TPM), `gene_length` (log1p; omitted if biomaRt unavailable).

OR > 1 for `in_module` indicates module genes are more likely to be miRNA targets
than equally expressed, equally long non-module genes.

```{r logistic_enrichment}
logistic_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tissue_expr_raw), function(tis) {
  detected     <- rownames(make_expr_mat(tissue_expr_raw[[tis]]))
  mod_tis      <- module_gene_meta %>% filter(tissue == tis)
  if (nrow(mod_tis) == 0) return(NULL)

  target_genes <- unique(mirna_pairs$SYMBOL[mirna_pairs$tissue == tis])

  expr_mean <- tissue_expr_raw[[tis]] %>%
    group_by(symbol) %>%
    summarise(expression_level = mean(Log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  med_len <- if (!is.null(gene_len_tbl)) median(gene_len_tbl$gene_length, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(mod_tis)), function(i) {
    module_genes <- intersect(mod_tis$gene_union[[i]], detected)

    df_lr <- tibble(gene      = detected,
                    in_module = as.integer(gene %in% module_genes),
                    is_target = as.integer(gene %in% target_genes)) %>%
      left_join(expr_mean, by = c("gene" = "symbol")) %>%
      mutate(expression_level = coalesce(expression_level, 0))

    if (!is.null(gene_len_tbl)) {
      df_lr <- df_lr %>%
        left_join(gene_len_tbl, by = c("gene" = "symbol")) %>%
        mutate(gene_length = log1p(coalesce(gene_length, med_len)))
    }

    if (sum(df_lr$in_module) == 0 || sum(df_lr$is_target) == 0) return(NULL)

    formula_lr <- if (!is.null(gene_len_tbl))
      is_target ~ in_module + expression_level + gene_length
    else
      is_target ~ in_module + expression_level

    tryCatch({
      fit <- glm(formula_lr, data = df_lr, family = binomial)
      ct  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
      if (!"in_module" %in% rownames(ct)) return(NULL)
      ci  <- tryCatch(exp(confint.default(fit)["in_module", ]),
                      error = function(e) c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
      tibble(
        tissue     = tis,
        module     = mod_tis$module[i],
        module_id  = mod_tis$module_id[i],
        n_detected = length(detected),
        n_module   = sum(df_lr$in_module),
        n_target   = sum(df_lr$is_target),
        n_overlap  = sum(df_lr$in_module == 1L & df_lr$is_target == 1L),
        OR         = exp(ct["in_module", "Estimate"]),
        CI_lo      = ci[1],
        CI_hi      = ci[2],
        p_value    = ct["in_module", "Pr(>|z|)"],
        log2OR     = log2(exp(ct["in_module", "Estimate"])),
        model      = if (!is.null(gene_len_tbl)) "in_module+expr+len" else "in_module+expr"
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }))
}))

logistic_results <- logistic_results %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

cat("Logistic regression complete:", nrow(logistic_results), "tissue-modules\n")
cat("OR > 1, p_adj < 0.05:", sum(logistic_results$OR > 1 & logistic_results$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("OR < 1, p_adj < 0.05:", sum(logistic_results$OR < 1 & logistic_results$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

logistic_results %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module, module_id, n_module, n_target, n_overlap,
                OR, CI_lo, CI_hi, p_value, p_adj) %>%
  print(n = 30)

write.csv(logistic_results,
          file.path(dir_output, "logistic_enrichment.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: logistic_enrichment.csv\n")
```

```{r logistic_forest, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
if (nrow(logistic_results) > 0) {
  mid_levels_lr <- logistic_results %>%
    arrange(tissue, desc(as.integer(module))) %>%
    pull(module_id) %>% unique()

  plot_df_lr <- logistic_results %>%
    mutate(
      module_id = factor(module_id, levels = mid_levels_lr),
      log2CI_lo = log2(pmax(CI_lo, 1e-6)),
      log2CI_hi = log2(pmax(CI_hi, 1e-6)),
      sig_label = case_when(p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                            p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",   TRUE          ~ "")
    )

  p_lor <- ggplot(plot_df_lr, aes(x = log2OR, y = module_id)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = log2CI_lo, xmax = log2CI_hi),
                   height = 0.3, color = "grey40", na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = p_adj < 0.05, size = -log10(p_adj + 1e-10)),
               shape = 21, color = "grey20") +
    geom_text(aes(x = log2CI_hi, label = sig_label),
              hjust = -0.3, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, color = "#D73027", na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey80", "TRUE" = "#D73027"),
                      name = "p_adj < 0.05") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), name = "-log10\n(p_adj)") +
    facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    labs(x = "log2(OR)  —  miRNA-target enrichment in module", y = NULL,
         title    = "Logistic regression: miRNA-target enrichment per tissue-module",
         subtitle = "Error bars = 95% CI (Wald);  filled = p_adj < 0.05") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom")

  n_mods_lr <- max(table(plot_df_lr$tissue))
  fig_h_lr  <- max(4, n_mods_lr * 0.45 + 2) * ceiling(n_distinct(plot_df_lr$tissue) / 3)
  print(p_lor)

  ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "logistic_enrichment_forest.png"),
         p_lor, width = 10, height = fig_h_lr, dpi = 150)
  ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "logistic_enrichment_forest.svg"),
         p_lor, width = 10, height = fig_h_lr)
  cat("Saved: logistic_enrichment_forest.png / .svg\n")
}
```

# 6b. Filter modules: OR > 1, p_adj < 0.05

Modules passing this filter are used in all subsequent analyses.

```{r filter_modules}
sig_mods <- logistic_results %>%
  filter(OR > 1, p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(tissue, module, module_id)

cat("Modules passing logistic filter (OR > 1, p_adj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_mods), "\n\n")
print(sig_mods %>% arrange(tissue, as.integer(module)), n = Inf)

module_gene_meta_filt <- module_gene_meta %>%
  semi_join(sig_mods, by = c("tissue", "module", "module_id"))

cat("\nFiltered module_gene_meta:", nrow(module_gene_meta_filt), "modules\n")

# Update step-1 to step-2 in funnel
step2_log <- module_gene_meta_filt %>%
  distinct(tissue, module) %>%
  mutate(step = "2_logistic_ok")

cat("\n=== Filtering funnel (steps 0–2) ===\n")
bind_rows(step0, step1, step2_log) %>%
  count(step) %>% arrange(step) %>% print()

write.csv(sig_mods, file.path(dir_output, "logistic_filtered_modules.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: logistic_filtered_modules.csv\n")
```

# 7. GSVA: Target score (logistic-filtered modules)

**Gene set**: `target_gene_union` ∩ detected genes (min `r MIN_TARGET_GENES` genes).

```{r run_gsva_target, message=TRUE}
gsva_target_mats   <- list()
target_meta_list   <- list()
target_geneset_list <- list()

for (tis in names(tissue_expr_raw)) {
  cat("\n──", tis, "──\n")
  expr_mat <- make_expr_mat(tissue_expr_raw[[tis]])
  detected <- rownames(expr_mat)
  mod_tis  <- module_gene_meta_filt %>% filter(tissue == tis)

  if (nrow(mod_tis) == 0) { cat("  No filtered modules — skipped\n"); next }

  target_sets <- setNames(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(mod_tis)), function(i)
      intersect(mod_tis$target_gene_union[[i]], detected)),
    mod_tis$module_id
  )
  cat("  Target sets:", sum(sapply(target_sets, length) >= MIN_TARGET_GENES),
      "valid (>=", MIN_TARGET_GENES, "genes),",
      sum(sapply(target_sets, length) < MIN_TARGET_GENES), "below min\n")

  target_meta_list[[tis]] <- mod_tis %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(n_target = length(intersect(target_gene_union, detected))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(module_id, n_target)

  res_tgt <- run_gsva_safe(expr_mat, target_sets, min_sz = MIN_TARGET_GENES)
  if (!is.null(res_tgt)) gsva_target_mats[[tis]] <- res_tgt
  target_geneset_list[[tis]] <- target_sets
}

cat("\nGSVA target score complete:", length(gsva_target_mats), "tissues\n")

target_list <- bind_rows(lapply(names(gsva_target_mats), function(tis) {
  gsva_to_long(gsva_target_mats[[tis]], tis, tissue_expr_raw[[tis]]) %>%
    rename(target_score = score) %>%
    left_join(target_meta_list[[tis]], by = "module_id")
}))
```

```{r save_target_genesets}
target_geneset_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(target_geneset_list), function(tis) {
  gs <- target_geneset_list[[tis]]
  bind_rows(lapply(names(gs), function(mid) {
    genes <- gs[[mid]]
    if (length(genes) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(tissue = tis, module_id = mid, gene = genes)
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(module = sub("^[^_]+_mod", "", module_id)) %>%
  arrange(tissue, module_id, gene) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module_id, module, gene)

cat("Target geneset rows:", nrow(target_geneset_df),
    "| modules:", n_distinct(target_geneset_df$module_id), "\n")
write.csv(target_geneset_df,
          file.path(dir_output, "target_score_genesets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: target_score_genesets.csv\n")
```

# 7b. Target score heatmap — defines combined figure row order

Hierarchical clustering with correlation distance (1 − Pearson r) and ward.D2 linkage.
The resulting row order is applied to all three panels in the combined figure (Section 10).

```{r target_heatmap, fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
target_tp <- target_list %>%
  group_by(tissue, module, module_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(target_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

target_mat <- target_tp %>%
  dplyr::select(module_id, timepoint, mean_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = mean_score) %>%
  column_to_rownames("module_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

tp_target_cols <- TIMEPOINT_LEVELS[TIMEPOINT_LEVELS %in% colnames(target_mat)]
target_mat     <- target_mat[, tp_target_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Hierarchical clustering: this object is reused in the combined figure
hc_target <- safe_hclust(target_mat,
                         dist_method = "correlation",
                         reorder_by  = row_peak_weights(target_mat))

row_order_combined <- if (!isFALSE(hc_target)) {
  rownames(target_mat)[hc_target$order]
} else {
  rownames(target_mat)
}

cat("Row order for combined figure (", length(row_order_combined), "modules ):\n")
cat(paste(row_order_combined, collapse = ", "), "\n")

row_tis_s <- sub("_mod.*$", "", rownames(target_mat))
ha_row_s  <- rowAnnotation(
  Tissue = anno_simple(row_tis_s, col = tissue_pal[row_tis_s]),
  annotation_name_side = "top", annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
)

n_tgt_df  <- target_list %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>% summarise(n_target = max(n_target), .groups = "drop")
n_tgt_vec <- setNames(n_tgt_df$n_target, n_tgt_df$module_id)
ha_row_r  <- rowAnnotation(
  n_miRNA_targets = anno_barplot(n_tgt_vec[rownames(target_mat)],
                                 gp = gpar(fill = "#E07B39"), width = unit(2, "cm")),
  annotation_name_side = "top", annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

ht_target <- Heatmap(
  target_mat,
  name              = "GSVA\n(target\nscore)",
  col               = col_fun,
  na_col            = "grey88",
  cluster_rows      = hc_target,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  column_order      = tp_target_cols,
  left_annotation   = ha_row_s,
  right_annotation  = ha_row_r,
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  column_title      = "Timepoint",
  column_title_side = "bottom",
  row_title         = paste0("Tissue-module (n = ", nrow(target_mat), ")"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_position = "leftcenter-rot")
)

draw(ht_target, merge_legend = TRUE)

png(file.path(dir_output, "target_score_heatmap.png"),
    width = 2600, height = max(1200, nrow(target_mat) * 30 + 400), res = 200)
draw(ht_target, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

svg(file.path(dir_output, "target_score_heatmap.svg"),
    width = 13, height = max(6, nrow(target_mat) * 0.15 + 2))
draw(ht_target, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

write.csv(target_tp, file.path(dir_output, "target_score_gsva_timepoint.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: target_score_heatmap.png / .svg\n")
```

# 8. GSVA: Pathway activity (exclusive_gene_union, logistic-filtered modules)

**Gene set**: `exclusive_gene_union` (DB genes − target genes) ∩ detected genes.
Target genes are excluded to eliminate shared-gene spurious correlation with target score.

```{r run_gsva_activity, message=TRUE}
gsva_activity_mats <- list()

for (tis in names(tissue_expr_raw)) {
  cat("\n──", tis, "──\n")
  expr_mat <- make_expr_mat(tissue_expr_raw[[tis]])
  detected <- rownames(expr_mat)
  mod_tis  <- module_gene_meta_filt %>% filter(tissue == tis)

  if (nrow(mod_tis) == 0) { cat("  No filtered modules — skipped\n"); next }

  act_sets <- setNames(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(mod_tis)), function(i)
      intersect(mod_tis$exclusive_gene_union[[i]], detected)),
    mod_tis$module_id
  )
  cat("  Activity sets (exclusive):",
      sum(sapply(act_sets, length) >= 1), "valid,",
      sum(sapply(act_sets, length) == 0), "empty\n")

  res_act <- run_gsva_safe(expr_mat, act_sets, min_sz = 1)
  if (!is.null(res_act)) gsva_activity_mats[[tis]] <- res_act
}

cat("\nGSVA pathway activity complete:", length(gsva_activity_mats), "tissues\n")

activity_list <- bind_rows(lapply(names(gsva_activity_mats), function(tis) {
  gsva_to_long(gsva_activity_mats[[tis]], tis, tissue_expr_raw[[tis]]) %>%
    rename(activity = score)
}))
```

# 9. Linear regression: pathway activity ~ miRNA target score

Model: `activity ~ target_score + factor(timepoint)`

FDR correction (BH) applied across all tissue-modules.

```{r regression}
reg_data <- activity_list %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module, module_id, sample.ID, timepoint, replicate, activity) %>%
  inner_join(
    target_list %>% dplyr::select(tissue, module, module_id, sample.ID, target_score),
    by = c("tissue", "module", "module_id", "sample.ID")
  )

cat("Regression data:", nrow(reg_data), "rows |",
    n_distinct(reg_data$module_id), "tissue-modules\n\n")

fit_regression <- function(df, mid) {
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(activity), !is.na(target_score))
  if (nrow(df) < 6 || var(df$target_score) < 1e-10) return(NULL)

  fit_one <- function(formula, model_label) {
    tryCatch({
      mod <- lm(formula, data = df)
      ct  <- summary(mod)$coefficients
      if (!"target_score" %in% rownames(ct)) return(NULL)
      tibble(
        tissue    = unique(df$tissue),
        module    = unique(df$module),
        module_id = mid,
        beta      = ct["target_score", "Estimate"],
        se        = ct["target_score", "Std. Error"],
        p_value   = ct["target_score", "Pr(>|t|)"],
        model     = model_label,
        n         = nrow(df)
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  fit_one(activity ~ target_score + factor(timepoint), "factor")
}

regression_results <- bind_rows(lapply(
  unique(reg_data$module_id),
  function(mid) fit_regression(filter(reg_data, module_id == mid), mid)
))

regression_results <- regression_results %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

cat("Regression complete:", n_distinct(regression_results$module_id),
    "tissue-modules |", nrow(regression_results), "rows\n\n")

regression_results %>%
  arrange(model, p_value) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, tissue, module, module_id, beta, se, p_value, p_adj, n) %>%
  print(n = 30)

write.csv(regression_results,
          file.path(dir_output, "regression_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: regression_results.csv\n")
```

# 10. Combined figure: Target score | Pathway activity | Forest plot

Row order is fixed by the target score hierarchical clustering (Section 7b).
Forest plot shows β with 95% CI from the factor model; filled circles = p_adj < 0.05.

```{r combined_figure, fig.width=22, fig.height=max(6, length(row_order_combined)*0.32 + 4)}

# ── Build activity matrix ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
act_tp <- activity_list %>%
  group_by(tissue, module, module_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_activity = mean(activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

act_mat <- act_tp %>%
  dplyr::select(module_id, timepoint, mean_activity) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = mean_activity) %>%
  column_to_rownames("module_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

tp_act_cols <- TIMEPOINT_LEVELS[TIMEPOINT_LEVELS %in% colnames(act_mat)]
act_mat     <- act_mat[, tp_act_cols, drop = FALSE]

# ── Shared row order: modules present in all three result sets ──────────────────
common_mods <- row_order_combined[
  row_order_combined %in% rownames(act_mat) &
  row_order_combined %in% unique(regression_results$module_id)
]
n_common <- length(common_mods)
cat("Modules in combined figure:", n_common, "\n")

tgt_comb <- target_mat[common_mods, , drop = FALSE]
act_comb <- act_mat[common_mods,    , drop = FALSE]

# ── Regression: factor model ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg_fct <- regression_results %>%
  filter(model == "factor") %>%
  dplyr::select(module_id, beta, se, p_adj)

beta_vec <- setNames(reg_fct$beta,  reg_fct$module_id)[common_mods]
se_vec   <- setNames(reg_fct$se,    reg_fct$module_id)[common_mods]
padj_vec <- setNames(reg_fct$p_adj, reg_fct$module_id)[common_mods]

ci_lo      <- beta_vec - 1.96 * se_vec
ci_hi      <- beta_vec + 1.96 * se_vec
x_rng      <- range(c(ci_lo, ci_hi, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
x_rng      <- x_rng + diff(x_rng) * c(-0.15, 0.15)
fill_vec   <- ifelse(!is.na(padj_vec) & padj_vec < 0.05, "#D73027", "grey80")

# ── Left heatmap: Target score ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
cell_sz    <- unit(6, "mm")
tissue_ann <- sub("_mod.*$", "", common_mods)

ra_tis <- rowAnnotation(
  Tissue = tissue_ann,
  col    = list(Tissue = tissue_pal),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(Tissue = list(title = "Tissue"))
)

ht_left <- Heatmap(
  tgt_comb,
  name              = "Target\nscore\n(GSVA)",
  col               = col_fun,
  na_col            = "grey88",
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  show_row_names    = TRUE,
  row_names_side    = "left",
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  column_title      = "Target score",
  column_title_side = "top",
  left_annotation   = ra_tis,
  border            = TRUE,
  width             = cell_sz * ncol(tgt_comb),
  height            = cell_sz * n_common,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_position = "leftcenter-rot")
)

# ── Center heatmap: Pathway activity ────────────────────────────────────────────
ht_center <- Heatmap(
  act_comb,
  name              = "Pathway\nactivity\n(GSVA)",
  col               = col_fun,
  na_col            = "grey88",
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  show_row_names    = FALSE,
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  column_title      = "Pathway activity",
  column_title_side = "top",
  border            = TRUE,
  width             = cell_sz * ncol(act_comb),
  height            = cell_sz * n_common,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_position = "leftcenter-rot")
)

# ── Right: Forest plot — implemented as a dummy heatmap body ────────────────────
# All NA cells render as white; grid drawing inside decorate_heatmap_body adds
# the CI bars and points.  This approach keeps all three panels in one HeatmapList
# so row heights are guaranteed to be identical.
forest_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_common, ncol = 1,
                     dimnames = list(common_mods, "β"))

ht_right <- Heatmap(
  forest_mat,
  name                  = "forest_bg",
  col                   = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "white")),
  na_col                = "white",
  cluster_rows          = FALSE,
  cluster_columns       = FALSE,
  show_row_names        = FALSE,
  show_heatmap_legend   = FALSE,
  column_names_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  column_title          = "β (95% CI)\n(factor model)",
  column_title_side     = "top",
  border                = TRUE,
  width                 = unit(50, "mm"),
  height                = cell_sz * n_common
)

ht_all <- ht_left + ht_center + ht_right

# ── Draw and decorate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_combined <- function() {
  draw(ht_all, merge_legend = TRUE,
       column_title    = "Logistic-filtered modules (OR > 1, p_adj < 0.05)",
       column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))

  # In decorate_heatmap_body the y viewport matches the heatmap body:
  # row i of common_mods (1 = top) sits at native y = n_common + 1 - i
  # with yscale = c(0.5, n_common + 0.5).
  decorate_heatmap_body("forest_bg", {
    pushViewport(viewport(xscale = x_rng,
                          yscale = c(0.5, n_common + 0.5)))

    # Zero reference line
    grid.lines(x  = unit(c(0, 0), "native"),
               y  = unit(c(0.5, n_common + 0.5), "native"),
               gp = gpar(col = "grey50", lty = "dashed", lwd = 1))

    for (i in seq_len(n_common)) {
      if (is.na(beta_vec[i])) next
      y_pos <- n_common + 1 - i

      # CI bar
      grid.segments(
        x0 = unit(ci_lo[i], "native"), y0 = unit(y_pos, "native"),
        x1 = unit(ci_hi[i], "native"), y1 = unit(y_pos, "native"),
        gp = gpar(col = "grey40", lwd = 1.5)
      )
      # Point
      grid.points(
        x    = unit(beta_vec[i], "native"),
        y    = unit(y_pos,       "native"),
        pch  = 21,
        size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
        gp   = gpar(fill = fill_vec[i], col = "grey20", lwd = 0.8)
      )
    }

    grid.xaxis(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
    popViewport()
  })
}

draw_combined()

png_h <- max(1200, n_common * 30 + 500)
png(file.path(dir_output, "combined_figure.png"), width = 4400, height = png_h, res = 200)
draw_combined()
dev.off()

svg(file.path(dir_output, "combined_figure.svg"),
    width = 22, height = max(6, n_common * 0.32 + 4))
draw_combined()
dev.off()

cat("Saved: combined_figure.png / .svg  (n =", n_common, "modules)\n")
```

  arrange(p_adj) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module, module_id, beta, se, p_value, p_adj, n) %>%
